Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about setting up groups, voice rooms, and learning tracks.

Is Connecto completely free?
Yes, 100%. All messaging, WebRTC voice channels, cybersecurity curriculum, and community features are completely free with zero subscription paywalls or hidden fees.
How secure are my voice and text communications?
All HTTP and WebSocket traffic runs over strict TLS 1.3 encryption. Voice calls utilize peer-to-peer WebRTC mesh encrypted with 256-bit DTLS-SRTP, ensuring your conversations are directly transmitted between participants without centralized audio recording.
What is the Learning Hub?
The Learning Hub is an integrated educational space designed to teach real-world computer networking, web protocols, and cryptography. Through visual modules and interactive milestones, members level up their practical skills from fundamentals to advanced architecture.
Does Connecto have a mobile app?
Yes! Connecto is available as an official native Android app (v4.6.5, 36.0 MB) engineered with Dark Luxury & Liquid Glass UI, AGSL GPU runtime shaders, Connecto Vault biometric & device screen lock, low-latency WebSockets chat, touch-scroll isolation gesture engine, and WebRTC mesh voice lounges. You can download the direct APK immediately by clicking any APK button or visiting /download/apk. It is verified and optimized for Android 7.0 (Nougat) all the way through Android 16+ (including Xiaomi / POCO HyperOS).

Privacy Policy

Zero-telemetry & AES-256 encrypted storage • Version 4.6.5
1. Zero-Knowledge End-to-End Encryption
Connecto direct chats are encrypted directly on sender devices using AES-256-GCM symmetric session keys derived via ECDH key agreements. The platform infrastructure acts purely as a cryptographic relay and has zero technical ability to inspect, read, or decipher message content.
2. Hardware Blackscreen Protection (FLAG_SECURE)
On mobile devices, Connecto enforces WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE to block unpermitted screen grabs, screenshots, and video screen recording software, guarding confidential conversation threads against host spyware.
3. Minimal Data Collection Policy
We collect strictly the minimum information necessary to operate your account: chosen username, salted and multi-hash password digests, and an optional recovery email for password reset OTPs. We never monetize, sell, or profile user behavioral metadata.
4. Voice Channels & WebRTC Spatial Mesh
Voice rooms operate over direct WebRTC peer connections or encrypted STUN/TURN relays. Audio packets are delivered in real time with hardware acoustic echo cancellation and studio noise suppression. No audio packets or room recordings are retained or monitored.
5. Zero Tracking & No Third-Party Ad Trackers
Connecto contains zero third-party advertising SDKs, zero cross-site behavioral cookies, and zero diagnostic tracking pixels.
6. Account Purge & Right to Erasure
You retain the unilateral right to permanently purge your account at any time via the Delete Account button at the bottom of Help & Support. Deletion initiates a cryptographic scrub of all database records across all tables.
📜

Terms of Service

Acceptable use & community standards • Version 4.6.5
1. Acceptance of Terms
By accessing Connecto via web or mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not accept these terms, you must discontinue using Connecto.
2. Cryptographic Architecture & Account Ownership
Your account identity and conversation keys belong to you. You are solely responsible for preserving your master password and 2FA recovery email. Because Connecto cannot decrypt your end-to-end encrypted session keys, lost keys cannot be restored by staff.
3. Acceptable Use Policy
Users may not utilize Connecto for transmitting malware, engaging in automated spam attacks, exploiting system infrastructure, or infringing on the rights and security of other individuals.
4. Voice Lounges & Spatial Rooms
Voice rooms are decentralized ephemeral mesh lounges. You agree not to broadcast unauthorized audio streams, harassment, or abusive content in public channels.
5. Account Deletion & Termination
You have the unconditional right to delete your account at any moment through Help & Support. System administrators reserve the right to suspend accounts actively attacking network integrity.
6. Modifications to Service
Connecto evolves continuously with security updates. Significant protocol modifications will be announced through platform release telemetry.

🛡️ Privacy & Security Charter • Public Beta

Public Beta Testing Notice: Connecto is in an active Public Beta Testing Stage. Data collection is strictly limited to diagnostic stability and crash telemetry. We do not sell or monetize user data.

1. Zero Data Selling: Connecto does not monetize, sell, or rent your communications or contact information to third-party ad brokers.

2. End-to-End Cryptography: WebSockets channels operate over TLS 1.3 encryption and WebRTC voice lounges utilize 256-bit DTLS-SRTP peer-to-peer encryption with ephemeral audio packets.

3. Strict 18+ Requirement: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or participate in the public beta testing program.

4. Right to Anonymity: You can purge or anonymize your user profile at any time directly through the Settings panel or by emailing privacy@connecto.fun.

5. Local Storage: Preferences like themes and sound toggles are safely stored on your local device.

Full Policy

📜 Terms of Use • Public Beta Program

Beta Testing Stage Agreement: Connecto is actively undergoing public beta testing. Services and APIs are provided on an "AS-IS" and "AS-AVAILABLE" basis.

1. Strict Age Requirement (18+): Users must be 18 years of age or older. Accounts belonging to minors are subject to immediate termination.

2. Community Respect: Harassment, hate speech, spamming, and illegal content distribution are strictly prohibited.

3. Educational Fair Use: Cybersecurity learning labs & CTF challenges must only be used for defensive learning and authorized security practice.

4. Account Integrity: Each member is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials and session tokens.
